Bun.spawn without an explicit `env` does not see process.env mutations made after startup (verified: child JJ_USER=UNSET after `process.env.JJ_USER = …`; passing `env: {...process.env}` shows it). My first criterion-5 driver tried to simulate the daemon-env case that way and proved nothing; the recorded runs set the variables in the driver's own process environment instead. The daemon is not affected: createDaemonRunner always passes `env: { ...environment.paneEnv, ...options?.env }`.
